title: New required boundary row extends an existing matrix
context: Claim V-CHAPEL-ACCESS in verification/test-claims.json has a primary test at the API/application boundary with cases ["key-route", "climb-route"]. Decision 004 (accepted) requires a third documented access route: the crypt passage.
request: Implement the crypt-passage chapel access route and add coverage for it.

expected.rationale: The crypt passage is a distinct accepted-decision branch of an already-owned claim, not a new claim (TG-02). It is added as a new case on the existing primary owner at the same boundary, not a new file or a new claim ID. TG-06 explicitly keeps decision-required boundary matrix rows valid even when they share implementation code.
